channel.title: Clintware™ Build Notes

item.title: Build the Operating System, Then Make It Reusable

item.title: Beyond Auto-Compaction: Quillgeist Moves to Delta-State Context
item.description: Why independent convergence with dlab’s CliffCompaction pushed Quillgeist from recursive summaries toward exact anchors, bounded working state, cold history, and just-in-time rehydration.

item.title: Think-Sculpting: When Thinking Becomes Building
item.description: How AI compresses the distance between an idea and a working test, and why faster building requires stronger guardrails, verification, and iteration.

item.title: Getting the Teams Background Just Right
item.description: How a specific visual requirement became a reusable background-generation workflow and public tool.

item.title: Building the Next Step
item.description: The builder-origin story behind Clintware: start with a real operating problem, build the smallest useful system, test it, and keep improving it.
